title: Smart Spawns
description: Respawning at world spawn sucks when your base is far. Smart Spawns lets you set your own, forever.
body:
# Smart Spawns (RESOURCE PACK REQUIRED - DOWNLOAD FROM VERSIONS TAB)
Respawning at world spawn sucks. Smart Spawns lets you set your own, forever. anywhere.

## DETAILS
Smart Spawns allows one to craft an item using redstone blocks, a compass and ender pearls called as "Spawn Setter". This item can be right clicked at a location in the Overworld, The Nether, The End (or any custom-dimension if the world contains any). Upon rightclicking that specific location becomes the permanent spawnpoint of ONLY that specific player. 

**EXCEPTIONS**:
1. When a player has a set-bed 
2. When a player has a set-respawn-anchor


## HOW TO INSTALL
1. Download the Datapack (and required Resource Pack) for your current game-version 
2. Upload the datapack to the datapacks folder (<worldname>/datapacks) 
3. Upload the resource pack and enable it on your clint side 
4. Restart/reload the server/world
5. Enjoy!

## FAQs 
Q.1 Why Is This Datapack Required If Beds/Respawn Anchor Exists? 
Consider this, You are exploring thousands of blocks away from your base and you had to use a bed somewhere else than your base meaning now you would respawn at Default World Spawn instead of your base. With Smart Spawns, you can now set beds and respawn anchors wherever you want and destroy them to respawn back to your personal default spawn. 

Q.2 Is This Compatible For Multiplayer? 
Yes, Each player can set their own spawns without any problems 

Q.3 Is This Compatible With Other Custom-World Generation Datapacks/Mods Like Terralith? 
Yes 


# ADMIN-COMMANDS

| **ADMIN COMMANDS**                  | **DETAILS**                                        |
|-------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `/function smartspawn:introduce`    | Gives the start-up menu description                |
| `/function smartspawn:give_spawn_setter` | Gives the respective player a Spawn Setter without crafting |
